# Elena Soloveva — Product Designer

> Product designer, seven years in design. Data-heavy platforms, mobile apps and products of my own: from user flows and structure to mockups, a design system and a prototype. Working remotely.

- Site: https://lenkka-solo.github.io/ (English), https://lenkka-solo.github.io/ru/ (Russian)
- Contact: Telegram https://t.me/lenkka_solo, email lenkka.solo@gmail.com
- CV: https://lenkka-solo.github.io/cv/Elena_Soloveva_CV_EN.pdf, https://lenkka-solo.github.io/cv/Elena_Soloveva_CV_RU.pdf

## Experience
- Makefolk, own product, 2026 to now: a workspace for designers, live at https://makefolk.app
- AgroPromCifra, UX/UI designer, Apr 2025 to 2026: government digital platforms with dashboards and solutions for agriculture (NDA)
- Travel insurance (NDA), UX/UI designer, Jan 2024 to Feb 2025
- Project Wave, web designer, Sep 2021 to Mar 2025

## Projects
Case studies on the site:
- [Makefolk](https://lenkka-solo.github.io/#makefolk): own product, a live workspace for designers, designed and built with AI
- [Klaris](https://lenkka-solo.github.io/#klaris): concept, pharmaceutical operations platform with a coded prototype
- [WatchTogether](https://lenkka-solo.github.io/#watchtogether): concept, a mobile app for watching films together
- [Brain Trainers](https://lenkka-solo.github.io/#trainers) ([Behance](https://www.behance.net/gallery/259006155/Brain-Trainers-EdTech-Platform-Redesign-UXUI)): personal concept, online brain trainers for school students: audit, user journey, design system and 55 screens
- [Aura AI](https://lenkka-solo.github.io/#aura) ([Behance](https://www.behance.net/gallery/250208511/Aura-AI-SaaS-Landing-Page-Design)): concept, landing page for an AI workspace assistant; the case page embeds the full landing that scrolls with the page
- [Unite](https://lenkka-solo.github.io/#unite): own product in design, a couples mobile app: shared tasks, goals, budget, memories and a daily mood check-in; 20 screens and key decisions

More work:
- [Aura AI](https://www.behance.net/gallery/250208511/Aura-AI-SaaS-Landing-Page-Design): AI SaaS landing page
- [Profreza24](https://www.behance.net/gallery/254563699/Profreza24-Website-for-Manufacturing-Company): manufacturing company website
- SaveFlow: own product, an AI library for screenshots, images and links (in beta)
